verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no bulk-action capability, such as acting on many candidates or jobs in a single operation from the UI, API, or MCP. The closest items do not qualify. Migrating spreadsheet candidates means calling a per-candidate create endpoint repeatedly, which is a developer building block. Posting one job to 200+ boards is a single-item distribution feature. The MCP server's copy, move, and rate actions are not documented as batch operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
